title: Necrosword vs All-Black: Marvel Lore
script: This is All-Black The Necrosword. This is Klyntar Symbiotes. So what's the difference? Most fans think Knull created symbiotes before weapons. They're wrong. All-Black The Necrosword All-Black was the very first primordial weapon forged by Knull from the shadow of a slain Celestial. But Klyntar symbiotes were created later as living offspring spawned from the Necrosword's dark divine mass. The Necrosword is the god-slaying father of all symbiotes. Follow for more.
